Setting.name: SignatureName
Setting.value: Windows Trellix Agent Shielding - Service Access

Setting.name: SignatureNotes
Setting.value:
(Refer to KB article 51504 for details about supported platforms.) This signature is one of the self-protection features of the Agent. Agent resources - which include files, registry keys, and services - are protected so that an attacker cannot disable the Agent so that it no longer offers protection. Only the Agent process is authorized to manipulate resources associated with itself. An attempt to modify any resources may indicate an intrusion event.
Shielding and enveloping are the framework used by Trellix HIP to protect applications such as web servers, databases and the Agent.

Shielding an application provides protection of the application against external access. The shield protects resources (for example, files, registry keys, processes) that are part of the protected application. A shielding event indicates that a process or user not related to the protected application is attempting to access one of its resources.

Enveloping an application protects resources not belonging to an application from being accessed by that application. The envelope contains all resources the application requires (for example, files, registry keys, processes). Trellix HIP allows the application to access the resources inside the envelope. Any attempt to access resources outside the envelope can signify malicious behavior and is blocked. Therefore, an envelope event indicates that a process or user related to the enveloped application is attempting to access a resource that is not inside the application's envelope.

Setting.name: SignatureFP
Setting.value:
This signature triggers as a false positive mostly because a user used control panel to control Agent service. To avoid this false positive a user should control the service from Trellix HIP console.
If you observe signature triggers or false positives that should be mentioned in this section, please refer to KB67561 in the Trellix Knowledge Base. https://kcm.trellix.com/corporate/index?page=content&id=KB67561
